technical_alerts.title: Multi-Batch Strangle Entry Anomaly on Expiry 051026 (8 SELL legs / 3002 lots)
technical_alerts.message: 8 SELL orders (3002 lots total) executed for expiry 051026 across local LaunchAgent and delayed GitHub Actions cron on 03–04 Oct 2026.
technical_alerts.fix_hint: Fixed & Guarded: (1) Added exchange-level check_existing_expiry_positions() + has_open_strangle_for_expiry() idempotency guard in strangle_bot.py, (2) Added automatic 2x SL bracket verification on duplicate skip, (3) Added /tmp/delta_strangle_bot.lock atomic mutex in run_daily.sh, and (4) Added concurrency group in daily_strangle.yml.

technical_alerts.title: GitHub Actions Run #6 FAILURE (workflow_dispatch)
technical_alerts.message: Re-running attach-sl-only returned HTTP 400 bracket_order_exists on legs that already had a 2x SL attached.
technical_alerts.fix_hint: Updated place_or_update_bracket_sl() to catch bracket_order_exists and treat existing SL brackets as idempotent success (verified in Runs #7 & #8).

technical_alerts.title: GitHub Actions Run #5 FAILURE (workflow_dispatch)
technical_alerts.message: Initial /v2/orders/bracket payload used nested bracket_stop_loss_order key instead of stop_loss_order.
technical_alerts.fix_hint: Updated bracket SL payload schema to match Delta Exchange India v2 specification.

technical_alerts.title: GitHub Actions Run #4 FAILURE (workflow_dispatch)
technical_alerts.message: Standalone POST /v2/orders with reduce_only=True was rejected under Portfolio Margin mode after 1-lot test entry.
technical_alerts.fix_hint: Migrated 2x Stop-Loss placement to POST /v2/orders/bracket with mark_price trigger method.
